description: An asked call let through by a standing pre-approval, not by a question: `approvedBy` is `auto` and the reason names why (full access, or this tool pre-approved for the loop). A call a person answered carries `approvedBy: person`; a call a rule allowed on its own carries `policy`. A reopened loop labels the call from this field: "approved by you" only for a person, "approved by you, auto" for this.

payload.reason: allowed: full access is on for this loop (user:1000)
